title: Execution Plane Split — Cursor Self-Hosted vs Fairwind Gate
news_context: Cursor 2026-09-02: Self-hosted machines — tool execution entirely on your network; codebase / build outputs / secrets stay on internal machines; agent loop, inference, and planning remain in Cursor cloud; tool outputs flow back and may contain code; transcripts may be processed and stored by Cursor; outbound HTTPS worker via `agent worker start`; Cursor never initiates inbound (https://cursor.com/changelog/self-hosted-machines, https://cursor.com/blog/self-hosted-machines)

My Machines connects a single laptop or VM for personal workflows; Team Pools are named queues for a team or enterprise, not tied to one repository; pools scale with demand and can hibernate idle machines then restore within a reconnect window
Cloud agents can execute on existing sandboxes: AWS Lambda, Coder, Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, Namespace, Vercel, E2B; computer use on Linux and Mac; Cursor-hosted dedicated VMs remain the default

Google 2026-09-02 aside (same-day cluster, not the core): Gemini 3.8 Flash + 3.8 Flash Cyber — workhorse intro $0.75/$3.75 per MTok until 2026-12-31, then $1.50/$7.50 from 2027-01-01; Cyber gated via Fairwind + CodeMender for trusted defenders (https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/3-8-flash-and-3-8-flash-cyber/, https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/safety-security/fairwind-program/)

Fairwind is a limited-access program for governments and trusted partners; CodeMender + 3.8 Flash Cyber find, verify, and fix vulnerabilities; 3.8 Flash ships CBRN and cyber-offense safeguards; 3.8 Flash Cyber has more permissive cyber mitigations and is limited to trusted defenders; 650+ participating partners; any Google Cloud customer can use CodeMender with public models on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform

Anthropic 2026-09-02 aside (not the core): background computer use in Cowork / Claude Code — macOS 15+ background default; Pro/Max; Team/Enterprise no (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14128542-let-claude-use-your-computer-in-cowork, https://x.com/claudeai/status/2095226833293685100). Desktop vs self-hosted vs Fairwind one-liner

Vendor-comparison map lens: Cognition / Devin already documented orchestration/execution-plane separation via Outposts (Devin Cloud planning/inference, per-session Devboxes for execution); Cursor self-hosted is the same axis as a first-party product, not a new taxonomy
